name: ESTEIO
meaning: Portuguese for a prop, strut, or stay — the member that keeps the work standing.
voice: Specify the standard. Do not say ‘high quality’.
English for export pages. Portuguese remains on drawings and delivery notes.
Never ‘innovative solutions’. Prefer ‘EN 12810 façade frames, 2.0 m lifts’.

colors.name: Safety
colors.role: Load line, CTA, live status. Never large fills.

clearSpace: Clear space equals the height of the three bars in the mark. Do not place type inside the bolt-hole square.
donts: Do not recolour the mark to safety orange as a fill.
Do not set the name in a script or slab serif.
Do not stretch the base-plate square.
Do not use gold, cyan, or lifestyle photography as brand colour.
